title: OPEC agrees to extend crude oil output cuts through Q3 2026
description: OPEC+ ministers agreed on Monday to maintain their current crude oil production cuts through the third quarter of 2026, supporting oil prices amid global demand uncertainty.
content: VIENNA, March 31 (Reuters) - OPEC+ ministers agreed on Monday to maintain their current crude oil production cuts through the third quarter of 2026, keeping the alliance's collective reduction at 3.66 million barrels per day. The decision, reached at a Vienna meeting, came as members sought to balance market stability against concerns over slowing global demand growth. Saudi Arabia's energy minister said the alliance remained committed to proactive management of supply. Brent crude rose 1.2 percent following the announcement, trading at $87.40 a barrel.
author: Ahmad Ghaddar, Alex Lawler
